title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Contract Fuel Price on Long Rentals
content:
Long Ridgeline Tool Rental rentals pay the contract fuel price for refuelling.

Long rentals pay the contract fuel price: on an agreement whose rental time includes a four-week period the refuelling charge is multiplied by 0.90; on one whose rental time includes weekly periods but no four-week period, by 0.95; on one billed in daily periods only, it is unchanged.

The multiplier acts on the priced refuelling, service fee included, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

The rate periods are those of the rental time lines on the agreement.

## Contract price table

| Rental time lines on the agreement | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| include a four-week period | 0.90 |
| include weekly periods, no four-week period | 0.95 |
| daily periods only | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (priced refuelling of 120.00)

| Periods billed | Figure |
|---|---|
| one four-week period | 108.00 |
| one week and three days | 114.00 |
| six days | 120.00 |
